comparison.objective: Hand-mount the last bicycle-tire bead section; candidate seats a collet in a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Distributed deformable-bead depression, slack management, and rolling over a rim versus localized rigid eccentric capture and snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Bead mounted all around without tube-risk shortcuts or damaging strike versus collet retained without deformation or nut damage.
comparison.reason: Both use a rolling motion, but one tests deformable tension redistribution and the other rigid retention geometry.
